anomalies.observed: On the Main Pump driver, the gate node NET0042 of the low-side N-MOSFET T6 (IRLR2905) is pulled UP to +3V3 through R7 (10 kΩ), while T5 (BT3904) can only pull it down. The analogous ATO-valve driver instead pulls its gate (NET0026) DOWN to GND through R49 (10 kΩ).
anomalies.expected: For a low-side N-channel switch (source at GND) the gate must be pulled down to the source/GND so the load is OFF by default and fails OFF; the spec describes both pumps as low-side switches pre-driven by a BT3904 level shifter, implying identical, default-OFF gate biasing.

evidence.quote: Page 3 (sheet 1), 'Main Pump': '+3V3' arrow → R7 10k → gate node NET0042 of T6 IRLR2905 (source to GND); 'ATO Valve': R49 10k from gate node NET0026 of T2 AO3400A to GND.

anomalies.impact: With the control line inactive (ESP32 pin low / T5 off) the main circulation pump gate is held at +3V3, so the pump energizes by default and fails ON, unlike the ATO valve which fails OFF. This inverts the intended drive polarity and removes the safe default state for the main pump.
